name: Granular activated carbon production; at plant - PROXY
description:
Production of average U.S. granular activated carbon (GAC). Scope of the developed inventory is limited to material inputs. 

Inventory data was collected from the Greater Cincinnati Water Works (GCWW) Richard Miller Treatment Plant,

processDocumentation.completenessDescription: Material input only. Relevant flows are missing. The mass balance for this process was not calculated.
processDocumentation.dataSelectionDescription: Primary data was provided by representatives of the Greater Cincinnati Water Works Richard Miller Treatment Plant.
processDocumentation.samplingDescription: Scope: Material inputs only.  Primary data was provided by representatives of the Greater Cincinnati Water Works Richard Miller Treatment Plant. Uncertainty ranges are not available for this data.
processDocumentation.useAdvice: Some relevant flows are missing. Consider sensitivity assessment or alternative data sources if activated carbon is an important source of impact in your product system.

sources.name: Xue et al (2019) LCA of Urban Water Systems

reviews.details:
Proof reading details: Passed
Other details: none

processDocumentation.intendedApplication:
This process is intended to be used as a background process by LCA practitioners, industry and the general public.



Situation C2 - Accounting, without system-external interatctions. The intended application is a purely descriptive accounting / documentation of the analysed system excluding existing interactions with other systems in the LCI model.
